title: Alan Alda & Wayne Rogers M*A*S*H TV Screen, 1970s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white snapshot photo taken directly off an analog CRT television screen showing actors Alan Alda as Hawkeye Pierce and Wayne Rogers as Trapper John McIntyre from the popular 1970s television series M*A*S*H. The scanlines from the broadcast television display are distinctly visible, making this a classic piece of home fan media culture from the era.
